summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Price Comparison feature. All 11 backend API tests passed and all frontend UI tests passed. The live DuckDuckGo search integration is working correctly, returning real-time prices from multiple furniture stores (Amazon, Wayfair, IKEA, Target, Overstock, Home Depot, Lowe's, etc.).

issues: Web results from DuckDuckGo don't have product images (shows placeholder icon) - expected since web search returns text results only

critical_code_review_comments: Live DuckDuckGo search integration is real and functional (NOT MOCKED) - returns actual store listings
Some web results show 'Check price' instead of actual price - this is expected as not all search results contain extractable price information
Curated products have generic names like 'Shopping Item' - this comes from the imported_products.json data, not a code issue
test_credentials: No authentication required for any endpoint
seed_data_creation: None needed - using existing curated products from imported_products.json
context_for_next_testing_agent: Price Comparison feature fully tested and working. Backend uses real DuckDuckGo search for live price lookups. Frontend modal displays loading state, store prices with Live/Current/Best Price badges, savings banner when price differences exist, and external links that open in new tabs. All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/products/compare?product_name=velvet+sofa - Returns live web results from multiple stores ✓
GET /api/products/compare?product_id={id} - Combines curated product with live web price lookups ✓
GET /api/products/compare without params - Returns error correctly ✓
GET /api/products/grouped?q=chair - Returns grouped products from curated database ✓
GET /api/products/grouped?q=sofa&live=true - Enriches top groups with live web prices ✓
frontend_ui_tests: Price Comparison modal opens when clicking TrendingDown button on product cards ✓
Modal shows loading state 'Searching stores for best prices...' ✓
Modal displays store prices with Live/Current/Best Price badges ✓
Modal shows savings banner when price differences exist ✓
Store external links open in new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer) ✓
